subject.title: [Feature]: feat: trigger session-memory hook on /compact command

question: Should bundled session-memory archive on all session:compact:before lifecycle events, only on manual /compact, or should memoryFlush/continuity remain the intended compaction-memory path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent contract affects manual versus automatic compaction, transcript retention, lifecycle event payload shape, and overlap with memoryFlush and continuity work.

options.title: Use Lifecycle Archive
options.body: Wire session-memory to session:compact:before with the needed transcript/session context so manual and automatic compaction share one archive contract.

options.title: Manual Compact Only
options.body: Add a /compact-specific archive path if maintainers want only user-invoked compaction to behave like /new and /reset.

options.title: Keep MemoryFlush/Continuity
options.body: Leave session-memory scoped to reset/new and document memoryFlush or continuity snapshots as the supported compaction preservation mechanism.

recommendation.title: Use Lifecycle Archive
recommendation.body: Wire session-memory to session:compact:before with the needed transcript/session context so manual and automatic compaction share one archive contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the compaction lifecycle hook surface most directly involved in the contract choice.
